# Dhamaka Blocks

> Free Indian-festive-themed block puzzle game for Android. Drag blocks onto a
> grid, clear full rows/columns, chain combos, beat your high score. Made in
> India. Offline play, free to install.

## Key facts
- Platform: Android (Google Play), free to install
- Genre: block puzzle (grid drag-and-drop, line-clear, combo scoring)
- Theme: Indian festive — saffron/gold palette, festival board themes
- Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dhamakagames.dhamakablocks
